name: dac7-validator
what_it_holds: TypeScript validator/CLI for OECD DPI / EU DAC7 XML platform-reporting schemas (the XSD structure platforms like Airbnb use to file seller income/nights data with EU tax authorities). No aggregate statistics or actual filings, but documents the exact fields (gross amount paid, number of transactions, property nights, address) that DAC7 filings must contain -- useful as a schema reference if we ever chase national tax-authority aggregate DAC7 publications.
why_useful: Gap 12 (EU DAC7 platform reporting statistics): shows what fields exist in the underlying filings even though no repo here holds published aggregates.
size_hint: small code repo, no data files
themes: Airbnb host-side datasets: superhost/multi-listing/professional host panels, host earnings, DAC7 platform-reporting statistics, IRS/tax authority STR income stats
why_all: Gap 12 (EU DAC7 platform reporting statistics): shows what fields exist in the underlying filings even though no repo here holds published aggregates.

name: dac7_reporter
what_it_holds: Application to submit signed DAC7 report files to a national DIP (Digital Platform) API. Compliance tooling for platforms filing seller/host income reports, not a statistics dataset.
why_useful: Same schema-reference value as dac7-validator; confirms DAC7 filings carry host-level gross-income and nights fields that in aggregate (if a tax authority ever publishes summary stats) would proxy host earnings.
